name: Titanium.WatchSession
summary: Used to enable data and file transfers between a watchOS and iOS application.
description:
WatchSession enables data and file transfers between a WatchKit application and a Titanium application
using the iOS Watch Connectivity framework introduced in iOS 9 and watchOS 2.

properties.name: ACTIVATION_STATE_ACTIVATED
properties.summary: The watch is currently activated.

properties.name: ACTIVATION_STATE_INACTIVE
properties.summary: The watch is currently inactive.

properties.name: ACTIVATION_STATE_NOT_ACTIVATED
properties.summary: The watch is currently not activated.

properties.name: activationState
properties.summary: Returns the current activation state of the watch.

properties.name: hasContentPending
properties.summary: Returns `true` if there is more content for the session to deliver.

properties.name: isActivated
properties.summary: Returns `true` if the watch is currently activated.

properties.name: isComplicationEnabled
properties.summary: Returns `true` if complication is enabled on the installed watch app.

properties.name: isPaired
properties.summary: Returns `true` if the device is paired with a watch.

properties.name: isReachable
properties.summary: Returns `true` if the watch is currently reachable.

properties.name: isSupported
properties.summary: Returns `true` if the device supports watch connectivity.

properties.name: isWatchAppInstalled
properties.summary: Returns `true` if the accompanying watch app is installed.

properties.name: recentApplicationContext
properties.summary: The most recent application context sent to the watch app.

properties.name: remainingComplicationUserInfoTransfers
properties.summary:
The number of calls remaining to `transferCurrentComplication` before the system starts 
transferring the complicationUserInfo as regular userInfos.

methods.name: activateSession
methods.description: Activates the watch session to make the app ready to receive messages from the watch app.

methods.name: cancelAllFileTransfers
methods.summary: Cancels all incomplete file transfers to the Apple Watch.
methods.description: Cancels all incomplete file transfers to the Apple Watch.

methods.name: cancelAllTransfers
methods.summary: Cancels all incomplete transfers to the Apple Watch.
methods.description: Cancels all incomplete transfers to the Apple Watch, including user info, complication and file.

methods.name: cancelAllUserInfoTransfers
methods.summary: Cancels all incomplete user info and complication transfers to the Apple Watch.
methods.description: Cancels all incomplete user info and complication transfers to the Apple Watch.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.summary: Sends a message to the Apple Watch.
methods.description: Sends a message to the installed watch app on the Apple Watch in the foreground.

parameters.name: message
parameters.summary:
Message to send to the Apple Watch. This property is required and the key of the dictionary 
needs to be a String.

parameters.name: reply
parameters.summary:
Function to be called upon receiving a reply from the watch app.

**Since Release 5.1.0**

This function is used to process the direct reply from the watch app after sending one.

inlined.name: MessageReply
inlined.summary: Reply message received from watch app.

properties.name: code
properties.summary: Error code. Returns 0 if `success` is `true`.
properties.description:
Error code will be 0 if `success` is `true`, nonzero otherwise. If the error
was generated by the operating system, that system's error value is used.
Otherwise, this value will be -1.

properties.name: error
properties.summary: Error message, if any returned.

properties.name: message
properties.summary: Reply message from watch app.

properties.name: success
properties.summary: Indicates if the operation succeeded.

methods.name: transferCurrentComplication
methods.summary: Transfers complication data to the watch application.
methods.description:
Transfers complication data to the installed watch app. This is only for
watch apps with complications enabled.

parameters.name: params
parameters.summary: Complication to be transferred to watch app.

methods.name: transferFile
methods.summary: Transfers a file to the Apple Watch.
methods.description:
Transfers a file to the installed watch app on the Apple Watch in the background. Subsequent
transfers are queued.

parameters.name: params
parameters.summary:
Pass an object with the following key-value pairs:

  * `fileURL` (String) (required): Local filesystem path of file to send to the watch app.
  * `metaData` (Dictionary) (optional): Additional information about the file to send to the watch app.

methods.name: transferUserInfo
methods.summary: Transfers an user info to the Apple Watch.
methods.description:
Transfers an user info object to the installed watch app on the Apple Watch in the background.
Subsequent transfers are queued.

parameters.name: params
parameters.summary: userInfo to be transferred to the Apple Watch.

methods.name: updateApplicationContext
methods.summary: Sends an app context update to the Apple Watch.
methods.description:
Sends an app context update to the Apple Watch. If watch app is in background during transfer,
watch app will fire the [Titanium.WatchSession.receiveapplicationcontext](api:Titanium.WatchSession#receiveapplicationcontext) event immediately when 
it becomes active. Only one app context is stored at any one time. Subsequent updates will simply 
replace the earlier one sent.

parameters.name: params
parameters.summary: App context to be updated in the Apple Watch.

events.name: activationCompleted
events.summary:
Called when the session has completed activation. If session state is 
[Titanium.WatchSession.ACTIVATION_STATE_NOT_ACTIVATED](api:Titanium.WatchSession#ACTIVATION_STATE_NOT_ACTIVATED) there will be an error 
with more details.

events.summary:
Called when the session can no longer be used to modify or add any new transfers and, 
all interactive messages will be cancelled, but events for background transfers can still fire. 
This will happen when the selected watch is being changed.
